title: QUANTITY OF AUSTRALIAN COLLECT...
reason: Large organised collection (thousands of cards in labelled series from 1950 to 1976, with spares) that the title undersells as 'quantity'; sets of this kind sell for about $10 to $40 each.
findings: The title ('quantity of Australian collectors cards') undersells a large, hand-catalogued accumulation: thousands of cards in rubber-banded bundles with handwritten index slips, held in two yellow plastic carry cases and a red tin inside a cardboard box. Series labels read: 1970 Cook's Voyage of Discovery; 1969 Australia Leads Ahead; 1969 Traditional Uniforms; 1969 The World of the Aborigine; 1968 This World of Speed; 1968 Secrets of Space (two bundles); 1968 The Iron Horses; 1960 Cavalcade of Cars; 1959 Destination Moon; 1958 Scouting and Guiding; 1958 The Book of Amazing Wonders; 1950 Aboriginal Tribes and Customs; Papua New Guinea; Wildflowers; numbered runs 1-96, 97-192, 193-288, 289-384 and 385-480 (one marked boxed, see notes); and bundles marked Spares and Special Books. The red tin holds colour nature cards (birds, butterflies, animals) with labels such as Trees 1966 and Adventurers / Explorers (2), which may be UK tea-card series, so the lot probably mixes Australian and overseas sets. A Ty-nee Tips 100 tea cup bags box ('NEW card series now available') and loose typed lists are included. No issuer name is visible on any card, so I cannot name the makers. A scrawl '5144/13 pob' is on the carton.
condition: Cards look sorted and mostly in good order on cream card stock with some toning; individual card condition and set completeness cannot be judged from the photos.
rescore_note: Big, carefully labelled accumulation (thousands of cards, a bundle marked complete sets, 1950 to 1970 series plus some overseas tea cards) but common issues, a thin collector market and unverified completeness, so lower mid-band.
